title: ZAFF4 native cubic and quartic support including four primitive coordinates
summary: Construct an explicitly local ZAFF4 candidate by rank-completing native mixed products on observed derivatives, preserving reference E/G/H and all dissociation switches.
gates: Actual sparse derivative observations only; unavailable four-distinct modal derivatives are not zero data
Native products include four distinct primitives; the fourth-order response uses a full-rank internal view
Reference energy, gradient, complete harmonic field and nonbonded contributions remain fixed
Every radial/angular/torsional mixed term retains all defining bond switches
A passing local fit produces a ZAFF4 candidate; physical promotion additionally requires parent ZAFF3 qualification, rank evidence, independent QM E/G/H, LAM/domain and asymptotic gates
Explicit remote host with 128 GiB per numerical process; new QM points use GDV with 128 GB each
coordinate_policy: Frozen source derivative gauge and atom order; native primitive products evaluated directly. Four-primitive support does not imply complete measured four-distinct modal force constants.
backend_policy: Resident ARCHITECT native E/G/H and rank-revealing fits under architect-zaff-hierarchy.v5. Missing independent electronic points belong to LINK/GDV. Reference consolidation: architect-zaff-hierarchy.v7 preserves the canonical parent forms; native PIC candidates require independent qualification.
